<div class="slides__carousel owl-carousel owl-loaded owl-drag" data-js-featured-carousel="carousel">
<div class="owl-stage-outer"><div class="owl-stage" style="transform: translate3d(0px, 0px, 0px); transition: all 0s ease 0s; width: 7200px;"><div class="owl-item active" style="width: 720px;"><div class="slide">
<img alt="" class="slide__background" src="/uploads/media/program/0001/04/f9ef1064cf8c9aad08dd1e4b5c49d92463787fdd.jpeg"/>
<div class="slide__body">
<p class="slide__note">20 Courses</p>
<h3 class="slide__heading">Foundation &amp; Design Program</h3>
<p class="slide__text">Whatever your likely career path - be it Character Design, Environment Design, Visual Effects, or another; it’s essential to gain a strong &amp; balanced understanding of good art design &amp; techniques. This is where our Foundation &amp; Design Program comes in.</p>
<a class="btn btn-border-warning btn-circle btn-lg text-uppercase font-weight-bold px-4" href="https://www.cgmasteracademy.com/programs/1">Learn more</a>
</div>
</div></div><div class="owl-item" style="width: 720px;"><div class="slide">
<img alt="" class="slide__background" src="/uploads/media/program/0001/04/8f8487cbee338d0d8927e00ccb8d31c34d8e2aa7.jpeg"/>
<div class="slide__body">
<p class="slide__note">21 Courses</p>
<h3 class="slide__heading">2D Character Design Program</h3>
<p class="slide__text">Our Character Design Program is designed to carefully build on those core foundational drawing skills to give students head-to-toe training in the art of human &amp; creature character design for the Entertainment Industries.</p>
<a class="btn btn-border-warning btn-circle btn-lg text-uppercase font-weight-bold px-4" href="https://www.cgmasteracademy.com/programs/2">Learn more</a>
</div>
</div></div><div class="owl-item" style="width: 720px;"><div class="slide">
<img alt="" class="slide__background" src="/uploads/media/program/0001/04/b1df32e8772cf066f9e399ed163dbda8190f04ea.jpeg"/>
<div class="slide__body">
<p class="slide__note">16 Courses</p>
<h3 class="slide__heading">2D Environment Design Program</h3>
<p class="slide__text">Our Environment Design Program is designed for those wanting to pursue a career in the film/animation or games industry.  Featuring classes that cover all aspects of design including matte painting, sketching, narrative illustration, &amp; composition.</p>
<a class="btn btn-border-warning btn-circle btn-lg text-uppercase font-weight-bold px-4" href="https://www.cgmasteracademy.com/programs/3">Learn more</a>
</div>
</div></div><div class="owl-item" style="width: 720px;"><div class="slide">
<img alt="" class="slide__background" src="/uploads/media/program/0001/04/5176d8a91c28dba0feaf19e3530199548df7e4a8.jpeg"/>
<div class="slide__body">
<p class="slide__note">23 Courses</p>
<h3 class="slide__heading">3D Character Arts Program</h3>
<p class="slide__text">Designed to take students through the entire process of character creation, &amp; developing the skills in their chosen specialist role, such as hard surface modeler, prop artist, texture artist, rigging artist, or creature designer</p>
<a class="btn btn-border-warning btn-circle btn-lg text-uppercase font-weight-bold px-4" href="https://www.cgmasteracademy.com/programs/4">Learn more</a>
</div>
</div></div><div class="owl-item" style="width: 720px;"><div class="slide">
<img alt="" class="slide__background" src="/uploads/media/program/0001/04/de6ca275b95b671ff69ed138746dc452d32b34a1.jpeg"/>
<div class="slide__body">
<p class="slide__note">18 Courses</p>
<h3 class="slide__heading">3D Environment Arts Program</h3>
<p class="slide__text">This program is designed to provide students with an inroad to the games industry. Students will take on the role of world builder &amp; create a sense of immersion. While refining the 3D content that helps define the aesthetic &amp; gameplay flow.</p>
<a class="btn btn-border-warning btn-circle btn-lg text-uppercase font-weight-bold px-4" href="https://www.cgmasteracademy.com/programs/5">Learn more</a>
</div>
</div></div><div class="owl-item" style="width: 720px;"><div class="slide">
<img alt="" class="slide__background" src="/uploads/media/program/0001/05/cedb973b467b0e3b3321ca11e9decd19512d402f.jpeg"/>
<div class="slide__body">
<p class="slide__note">10 Courses</p>
<h3 class="slide__heading">Character TD | Rigging Program</h3>
<p class="slide__text">Our in-depth Character TD/Rigging Program takes students through the tools &amp; techniques used by animation, visual effects, &amp; game studios. Students will learn to build rigs for a wide variety of character types, using the latest industry-standard methods.</p>
<a class="btn btn-border-warning btn-circle btn-lg text-uppercase font-weight-bold px-4" href="https://www.cgmasteracademy.com/programs/6">Learn more</a>
</div>
</div></div><div class="owl-item" style="width: 720px;"><div class="slide">
<img alt="" class="slide__background" src="/uploads/media/program/0001/04/79de3a058c29c00e47496ac96c163b8331c79263.jpeg"/>
<div class="slide__body">
<p class="slide__note">12 Courses</p>
<h3 class="slide__heading">Houdini | FX Program</h3>
<p class="slide__text">One of the more demanding roles in Visual Effects &amp; Games. Our Houdini/FX Program comes in with a comprehensive suite of classes. Students will master pyro and fluid effects, cloth, crowds, destruction, and more.</p>
<a class="btn btn-border-warning btn-circle btn-lg text-uppercase font-weight-bold px-4" href="https://www.cgmasteracademy.com/programs/7">Learn more</a>
</div>
</div></div><div class="owl-item" style="width: 720px;"><div class="slide">
<img alt="" class="slide__background" src="/uploads/media/program/0001/04/b6c61b64ed8faaa26b6b8acff1e4d989aa014dd7.jpeg"/>
<div class="slide__body">
<p class="slide__note">3 Courses</p>
<h3 class="slide__heading">Compositing | Lighting Track</h3>
<p class="slide__text">Developed by mentors with extensive industry experience. This program features classes that teach students the ins &amp; outs of lighting using raytrace renderer Arnold, Node-Based compositing tool Nuke, &amp; the science, technology, &amp; art of lighting for games.</p>
<a class="btn btn-border-warning btn-circle btn-lg text-uppercase font-weight-bold px-4" href="https://www.cgmasteracademy.com/programs/8">Learn more</a>
</div>
</div></div><div class="owl-item" style="width: 720px;"><div class="slide">
<img alt="" class="slide__background" src="/uploads/media/program/0001/04/f5547460ec46546b8685cdf8081066038ce94565.jpeg"/>
<div class="slide__body">
<p class="slide__note">13 Courses</p>
<h3 class="slide__heading">Storytelling &amp; IP Development Program</h3>
<p class="slide__text">Designed to equip artists with the necessary tools to become visual communicators &amp; ultimately develop their own storytelling language. Whether they’re focused on Concept Art, Comics, Filmmaking, Storyboarding, or Character/Environment Design.</p>
<a class="btn btn-border-warning btn-circle btn-lg text-uppercase font-weight-bold px-4" href="https://www.cgmasteracademy.com/programs/9">Learn more</a>
</div>
</div></div><div class="owl-item" style="width: 720px;"><div class="slide">
<img alt="" class="slide__background" src="http://placehold.it/1429x940"/>
<div class="slide__body">
<p class="slide__note">0 Courses</p>
<h3 class="slide__heading">Test Program</h3>
<p class="slide__text"></p>
<a class="btn btn-border-warning btn-circle btn-lg text-uppercase font-weight-bold px-4" href="https://www.cgmasteracademy.com/programs/11">Learn more</a>
</div>
</div></div></div></div><div class="owl-nav disabled"><button class="owl-prev" role="presentation" type="button"><span aria-label="Previous">‹</span></button><button class="owl-next" role="presentation" type="button"><span aria-label="Next">›</span></button></div><div class="owl-dots"><button class="owl-dot active" role="button"><span></span></button><button class="owl-dot" role="button"><span></span></button><button class="owl-dot" role="button"><span></span></button><button class="owl-dot" role="button"><span></span></button><button class="owl-dot" role="button"><span></span></button><button class="owl-dot" role="button"><span></span></button><button class="owl-dot" role="button"><span></span></button><button class="owl-dot" role="button"><span></span></button><button class="owl-dot" role="button"><span></span></button><button class="owl-dot" role="button"><span></span></button></div></div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<script type="riot/tag">
    var ClassesStorageMixin = {
        lsKey: 'or-courses',
        addedClasses: [],
        registerLink: '',
        classAdded: false,
        init: function () {
            window.addEventListener('storage', function (e) {
                if (e.key == this.lsKey) {
                    this.getAddedClasses();
                }
            }, false);

            setInterval(function () {
                this.getAddedClasses();
            }.bind(this), 100);
        },
        getAddedClasses: function () {
            this.addedClasses = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(this.lsKey)) || [];
            this.classAdded = this.addedClasses.indexOf(this.opts.ref) >= 0;

            this.update();
            return this.addedClasses;
        },
        setAddedClasses: function (classesArray) {
            this.addedClasses = classesArray || [];
            localStorage.setItem(this.lsKey, JSON.stringify(classesArray));
        },
        addClass: function (classId) {
            if (classId) {
                this.addedClasses.push(classId);
                this.setAddedClasses(this.addedClasses);
                this.classAdded = (classId == this.opts.ref);

                this.getAddedClasses();
                $.post('/cart/add/' + classId, function(cart_items) {
                    if($.isArray(cart_items)) {
                        $('.shopping_cart__counter').text(cart_items.length);
                    }

                });
            }
        },
        removeClass: function (classId) {
            var currentClassIndex = -1;


            if (!classId) {
                return false;
            }

            currentClassIndex = this.addedClasses.indexOf(classId);
            $.post('/cart/remove/' + classId, function(cart_items) {
                    if($.isArray(cart_items)) {
                        $('.shopping_cart__counter').text(cart_items.length);
                    }
            });

            if (currentClassIndex >= 0) {
              this.addedClasses.splice(currentClassIndex, 1);
              this.setAddedClasses(this.addedClasses);
              this.classAdded = !(this.opts.ref == classId);
            }
        },
        removeKey: function () {
            localStorage.removeItem(this.lsKey);
        }
    };

    <shopping-cart>
      <a
        href="/cart"
        class={ 'btn btn-default border-0 navbar-btn shopping_cart': true, 'shopping_cart-empty_': addedClasses.length == 0 }
      >
        <img src={opts.image} alt="" class="" width="30" height="30">
        <sup
          if={ addedClasses.length }
          class="shopping_cart__counter"
        >
          { addedClasses.length }
        </sup>
      </a>

        this.mixin(ClassesStorageMixin);
    </shopping-cart>
    <mobile-shopping-cart class="pull-right">
      <a
        href="/cart"
        class={ 'btn border-0 navbar-btn shopping_cart text-white visible-xs': true, 'shopping_cart-empty_': addedClasses.length == 0 }
      >
        <img src={opts.image} alt="" class="" width="30" height="30">
        <sup
          if={ addedClasses.length }
          class="shopping_cart__counter"
        >
          { addedClasses.length }
        </sup>
      </a>

        this.mixin(ClassesStorageMixin);
    </mobile-shopping-cart>

    <video-play-list>
      <div class="columns columns-responsive columns-align_stretch playlist">
        <div class="columns__col columns__col-space_no columns__col-width_wide">
          <video crossorigin playsinline id="player" controls></video>
        </div>
        <div class="columns__col columns__col-space_no playlist__list">
          <div
            each={ video, index in videos }
            class={ playlist__item: true, 'playlist__item-active': index == activeVideoIndex }
            onclick={ () => { this.setActiveVideo(index) } }
          >
            <span class="playlist__item_play fa fa-play"></span>
            <img src={ video.poster } class="playlist__item_poster" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      var player = null;
      this.videos = window[opts.listFrom];
      this.activeVideoIndex = 0;

      setActiveVideo (index) {
        var activeVideo = this.videos[index];

        this.activeVideoIndex = index;

        if (activeVideo.provider == 'youtube' || activeVideo.provider == 'vimeo') {
          player.source = {
            type: 'video',
            sources: [
                {
                  src: activeVideo.src,
                  provider: activeVideo.provider
                }
            ],
          };
        }

        if (activeVideo.provider == 'local') {
          player.source = {
            type: 'video',
            sources: [
                {
                  src: activeVideo.src,
                  type: 'video/mp4'
                }
            ],
            poster: activeVideo.poster
          };
        }

      }

      this.on('mount', function () {
        player = new Plyr('#player', {
          controls: [
            'play-large',
            'play'
          ]
        });

        this.setActiveVideo(this.activeVideoIndex);
      });
    </video-play-list>

    <course-video-play-list post>
      <div class="columns columns-responsive columns-align_stretch course_playlist">
        <div class="columns__col columns__col-space_no columns__col-width_wide video_player">
          <video crossorigin playsinline id="player" controls></video>
        </div>
        <div class="columns__col columns__col-space_no course_playlist__body">
          <div class="course_playlist__list">
            <div
              each={ video, index in videos }
              class={ course_playlist__item: true, 'course_playlist__item-active': index == activeVideoIndex }
              onclick={ () => { this.setActiveVideo(index) } }
            >
              <div class="course_playlist__item_preview">
                <span class="playlist__item_play fa fa-play"></span>
                <img src={ video.poster } class="playlist__item_poster" />
              </div>
              <div class="course_playlist__item_body">
                  <h3 class="course_playlist__item_title">
                    { video.title }
                  </h3>
                  <p class="course_playlist__item_time">
                    { video.time }
                  </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      var player = null;
      this.videos = window[opts.listFrom];
      this.activeVideoIndex = 0;

      setActiveVideo (index) {
        var activeVideo = this.videos[index];
        this.activeVideoIndex = index;

        if (activeVideo.provider == 'youtube' || activeVideo.provider == 'vimeo') {
          player.source = {
            type: 'video',
            sources: [
                {
                  src: activeVideo.src,
                  provider: activeVideo.provider
                }
            ],
            poster: activeVideo.poster

          };
        }

        if (activeVideo.provider == 'local') {
          player.source = {
            type: 'video',
            sources: [
                {
                  src: activeVideo.src,
                  type: 'video/mp4'
                }
            ],
            poster: activeVideo.poster
          };
        }
        player.poster = activeVideo.poster
      }

      this.on('mount', function () {
        player = new Plyr('#player', {
          controls: [
            'play-large',
            'play',
            'volume',
            'mute',
          ]
        });
        this.setActiveVideo(this.activeVideoIndex);
      });
    </course-video-play-list>

    <video-player class="video_player ">
      <video crossorigin playsinline ref="player"></video>
      var player = null;

      this.on('mount', function () {
        player = new Plyr(this.refs.player, {
          autoplay: ('autoplay' in this.opts)
        });

        if ('autoplay' in this.opts) {
          player.on('ready', () => {
            player.play();
          });
        }

        if (this.opts.provider == 'youtube' || this.opts.provider == 'vimeo') {
          player.source = {
            type: 'video',
            sources: [
                {
                  src: this.opts.src,
                  provider: this.opts.provider
                }
            ],
            
          };
        }
        if (this.opts.provider == 'local') {
          player.source = {
            type: 'video',
            sources: [
                {
                  src: this.opts.src,
                  type: 'video/mp4'
                }
            ],
            poster: this.opts.poster
          };
        }
      });
    </video-player>

    <video-player-header class="video_player header__bg_video">
      <video crossorigin playsinline muted allow="autoplay" ref="player"></video>
      var player = null;

      this.on('mount', function () {
        player = new Plyr(this.refs.player, {
        });

        if ('autoplay' in this.opts) {
          player.on('ready', () => {
            player.play()
          });
        }
        if (this.opts.provider == 'youtube' || this.opts.provider == 'vimeo') {
          player.source = {
            type: 'video',
            sources: [
                {
                  src: this.opts.src,
                  provider: this.opts.provider,
                }
            ],
            
          };
        }
        if (this.opts.provider == 'local') {
          player.source = {
            type: 'video',
            sources: [
                {
                  src: this.opts.src,
                  type: 'video/mp4'
                }
            ],
            poster: this.opts.poster
          };
        }
        player.on('ended', event => {
          setTimeout(function() { player.play()} , 500);
        });
      });
    </video-player-header>

    <search-form>
      <div class="input-group rounded-0 input-lg px-0 pb-1 pt-0 form__has_suggests">
        <input
          id="search-query"
          ref="searchQuery"
          min="4"
          name="q"
          type="text"
          class="form-control border-0 rounded-0"
          placeholder="What do you want to learn?"
          list="search-autosuggest-list"
          oninput={ handleChange }
          onkeydown={ handleKeyPress }
          autocomplete="off"
        >
        <span class="input-group-btn">
          <div
            class={ 'btn btn-lg btn-default border-0 pr-0': true, 'form__invisible': !isFetching }
          ><i class="fa fa-2x fa-circle-o-notch fa-spin"></i></div>
        </span>
        <span class="input-group-btn">
          <button
            class="btn btn-lg btn-default border-0 pr-0"
            ref="submitSearch"
            type="submit"
          ><i class="fa fa-2x fa-search"></i></button>
        </span>
      </div>

      var component = this;

      component.isFetching = false;

      this.on('mount', function () {
        $(component.refs.searchQuery).easyAutocomplete({
          url: function (query) {
            return '/search/suggest?q=' + query
          },
          getValue: 'value',
          requestDelay: 300,
          list: {
            maxNumberOfElements: 42,
        		match: {
        			enabled: false
        		},
            onChooseEvent: function () {
              component.refs.submitSearch.click();
            },
            onLoadEvent: function () {
              component.isFetching = false;
              component.update();
            }
        	},
          minCharNumber: 3,
          adjustWidth: false
        });
      })

      component.handleChange = function (e) {
        var query = e.target.value;

        if (query && query.trim()) {
          query = query.trim();

          if (query.length >= 3) {
            component.isFetching = true;
          }
        }
      }

      component.handleKeyPress = function (e) {
        try {
          $('#eac-container-search-query ul li.selected')[0].scrollIntoView({
            behavior: "smooth",
            block: "center"
          });
        } catch (err) {}
      }
    </search-form>

    <countdown-timer>
      <div class="countdown">
        <div if={!state.isCompleted} class="title">
          Enrollment closing in
        </div>
        <div if={state.isCompleted} class="title">
          Enrollment closed
        </div>
        <div if={!state.isCompleted} class="calendar">
          <div class="calendar_section">
            <div class="calendar_section__value">
              {state.days}
            </div>
            <div class="calendar_section__caption">
              days
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="calendar_separator">:</div>
          <div class="calendar_section">
            <div class="calendar_section__value">
              {zeroPad(state.hours)}
            </div>
            <div class="calendar_section__caption">
              hrs
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="calendar_separator">:</div>
          <div class="calendar_section">
            <div class="calendar_section__value">
              {zeroPad(state.minutes)}
            </div>
            <div class="calendar_section__caption">
              min
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="calendar_separator">:</div>
          <div class="calendar_section">
            <div class="calendar_section__value">
              {zeroPad(state.seconds)}
            </div>
            <div class="calendar_section__caption">
              sec
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      var component = this;

      component.state = {
        days: 0,
        hours: 0,
        minutes: 0,
        seconds: 0,
        isCompleted: false
      };

      component.zeroPad = function (value) {
        var length = 2;
        var strValue = String(value);

        return strValue.length >= length ? strValue : ('0'.repeat(length) + strValue).slice(length * -1);
      };

      var updateState = function () {
        var nowTime = new Date().getTime();
        var distance = opts.date - nowTime;

        var days = Math.floor(distance / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        var hours = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
        var minutes = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
        var seconds = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
        var isCompleted = distance < 0;

        component.state = {
          days: days,
          hours: hours,
          minutes: minutes,
          seconds: seconds,
          isCompleted: isCompleted
        };

        if (isCompleted) {
          clearInterval(timer);
        }

        component.update();
      };

      updateState();

      var timer = setInterval(updateState, 1000);

      <style>
        .countdown {
          margin: 24px 0;
          display: flex;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .title {
          color: #ff7302;
          font-size: 18px;
          text-transform: uppercase;
          margin: 12px 24px 0 0;
        }

        .calendar {
          display: flex;
        }

        .calendar_section {
          margin: 0 1vw;
          color: #fff;
          text-align: center;
          min-width: 56px;
        }

        .calendar_separator,
        .calendar_section__value {
          font-size: 27px;
        }

        .calendar_separator {
          position: relative;
          top: -2px;
        }

        .calendar_section__caption {
          text-transform: uppercase;
        }
      </style>
    </countdown-timer>

    <modal>
      <div>
        <div
          onclick={ handleModalToggle }
          class="modal__toggler"
        >
          <yield from="toggler" />
        </div>
        <div
          class="modal__wrapper"
          if={ modalIsVisible }
          onclick={ handleModalToggle }
        >
          <div
            class="modal__box"
            onclick={ handleBoxClick }
          >
            <div class="modal__box_content">
              <yield from="modal" />
            </div>
            <div
              class="modal__box_close"
              onclick={ handleModalToggle }
            >
              <i class="fa fa-times"></i>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      this.modalIsVisible = false;
      this.keyUpEventListener = null;

      this.handleModalToggle = () => {
        this.modalIsVisible = !this.modalIsVisible;
      };

      this.handleBoxClick = (ev) => {
        ev.stopPropagation();
      };

      this.on('mount', () => {
        document.addEventListener('keyup', (event) => {
          if (event.defaultPrevented) {
              return;
          }

          var key = event.key || event.keyCode;

          if (key === 'Escape' || key === 'Esc' || key === 27) {
              if (this.modalIsVisible) {
                this.modalIsVisible = false;

                this.update();
              }
          }
        });
      });

      this.on('unmount', () => {
        document.removeEventListener(this.keyUpEventListener);
      });

      <style>
        .modal__wrapper {
          position: fixed;
          top: 0;
          left: 0;
          right: 0;
          bottom: 0;
          z-index: 9999;
          background-color: hsla(0, 0%, 0%, 0.8);
        }

        .modal__toggler {
          cursor: pointer;
        }
        .modal__toggler a {
          cursor: default;
          pointer-events: none;
        }

        .modal__box {
          position: fixed;
          top: 50%;
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
          left: 50%;
          border-radius: 4px;
          background: #fff;
          padding: 4px;
          box-sizing: border-box;
          min-width: 300px;
          min-height: 60px;
          max-width: 800px;
          max-height: 600px;
          width: 80vw;
        }

        .modal__box_content {
          overflow: scroll;
          max-height: 100%;
        }

        .modal__box_close {
          cursor: pointer;
          position: absolute;
          right: 0;
          bottom: -68px;
          font-size: 48px;
          color: #fff;
        }
      </style>
    </modal>
</script>
